description:
Use this when you need an auditable Singapore working-day count for a pinned year. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an employer-specific rest-day roster, bank/exchange closures or future years.
What it computes: Counts Singapore working and non-working dates in a 2026-2027 range using MOM public holidays and the CLDR Saturday/Sunday baseline.
Example user requests: Count Singapore working days from 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-15.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-01","end_date":"2027-02-15","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += singapore status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/singapore-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/singapore-working-days-between.md
name: count_singapore_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Singapore national public holidays plus the CLDR Saturday/Sunday baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or MOM public holiday.

holiday_names.description: MOM holiday names applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when the source explicitly publishes an observed date.

rest_day_policy.description: Employer-specific weekly rest-day placement is not inferred.

source_quality.description: Official Singapore government sources, with employer-rest-day limitation.

sources.description: Official MOM, government open-data and legislation sources.

weekend_days.description: CLDR weekend convention used only as the baseline.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Singapore Official Working Days
